Group rides in Wisconsin

13 recurring group rides around Wisconsin: 8 road, 7 social, 1 cruiser. 11 roll on weeknights, 0 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Market to Music Ride in Green Bay — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Broken Spoke Monday Night Road Ride runs b group pace, 18–20 mph average.
